description: Compensation Explorer gives compensation teams an interactive view of annual full-time-equivalent pay in EUR. Compare employee distributions with supplied internal pay bands or separate job and grade market references. Combine employee jitter, violin and box plots, group by business categories, and explore the distribution using independent X and Y zoom. A shorter pay selector presents eight headline pay measures while retaining all 21 supported amounts in employee details. Group by band, grade, job, position, job family, company, department or location. Bound Power BI field formats are respected. Mixed internal bands display a clearly identified calculated envelope and an employee-weighted mean of supplied midpoints. Pay Gap provides a descriptive, unadjusted comparison of women and men using mean or median. Reference coverage and missing or incompatible references remain visible. Use one employee per snapshot. The visual imposes no employee-count cap; Power BI data-volume and client-memory limits still apply. Prepared compensation components and totals are used as supplied, without automatic summation. The visual makes no external runtime requests and is available in English and German. The sample uses synthetic data.
